## Required

ROS 4.2.0 has five fields, three mandatory: trip/set identities and a combined hook type/size or terminal-device code.

Percentage and variations are optional.

## Available

The 2025 review covers 67 trips (17 observer-monitored, 50 self-reporting) and 461 sets.

Of 825 hook composition rows, 293 have known sizes, 530 explicitly say Unknown and two have no size.

Every self-reporting composition uses Unknown. Percentages total 100% per set; no offsets are populated.

## To decide

Match actual type/size combinations to ROS codes. Fixed sizes would discard or invent recorded detail.

Agree treatment of unknown or unsupported combinations; the reviewed ROS list has no generic unknown hook code.

Resolve categories that share a target code before combining their percentages.

The database allows settings without hook-detail rows. Reporting requirements remain open.
